title: Finance Control and Cash Visibility
summary: Strengthened financial discipline through integrated workflows, controlled planning, receivables management, and management visibility.

projectItems.title: Financial Workflow Automation
projectItems.summary: Integrated invoicing, procurement, and receivables workflows with task creation, tracking, and monitoring.
projectItems.problemStatement: Financial processes were manual, fragmented, and difficult to monitor in real time.
projectItems.solution: Connected core finance workflows and introduced structured automation and tracking mechanisms.
projectItems.impact: Improved process consistency, financial visibility, and control over operational hand-offs.
projectItems.leadershipValue: Shows systems thinking across finance operations, controls, and execution reliability.

projectItems.title: Receivable Management
projectItems.summary: A CRM-led receivables system for due, paid, and void invoice synchronisation, ageing visibility, and collection workflows.
projectItems.problemStatement: Collection follow-up required more reliable invoice status, ageing, activity, and ownership visibility.
projectItems.solution: Designed scheduled synchronisation from finance systems, a receivable record model, and structured CRM task actions.
projectItems.impact: Created a more disciplined operating rhythm for invoice monitoring and collection follow-up.
projectItems.leadershipValue: Connects financial data, customer follow-up, and accountable action management.

projectItems.title: Cash Flow Management
projectItems.summary: A cash-planning application for actual and projected inflows, outflows, opening balances, and cash-position monitoring.
projectItems.problemStatement: Cash decisions relied on scattered data and planning dates that were not consistently controlled or auditable.
projectItems.solution: Built a Creator-based planning layer with an outflow calendar, date-change history, projections, and dashboard views sourced from Books and Analytics.
projectItems.impact: Improved the structure and auditability of cash planning while preserving accounting-source data.
projectItems.leadershipValue: Demonstrates financial governance design across operational planning and executive visibility.

projectItems.title: Corporate Expense Allocation
projectItems.summary: A controlled, headcount-based workflow for allocating corporate expense across business verticals and preparing reviewable journal entries.
projectItems.problemStatement: Manual shared-cost allocation created repetitive month-end work and weak traceability.
projectItems.solution: Built a workflow to retrieve monthly P&L data, maintain headcount ratios, calculate allocations, review draft journals, and post approved entries.
projectItems.impact: Reported user feedback indicates six hours of monthly saving while strengthening month-end allocation control.
projectItems.leadershipValue: Turns a recurring finance task into a repeatable control process that supports profitability decisions.

projectItems.title: Finance Task Management
projectItems.summary: A prototype dashboard that consolidates Zoho Books task health, workload, priority, and overdue work across organisations.
projectItems.problemStatement: Finance backlog and ownership were dispersed across entity-specific task views.
projectItems.solution: Created a unified Director view and personal follow-up view from a normalised task dataset.
projectItems.impact: Prototype released for review; UAT, time-saving, and ROI evidence are pending.
projectItems.leadershipValue: Shows a disciplined approach to operational visibility without overstating unverified outcomes.
